content: {"reasoning":"The payer has adjudicated CPT 93271 as bundled and not separately payable under CO-97, and both an appeal and peer-to-peer request have already been attempted. Resubmission would not cure bundling, authorization is neither required nor available retroactively, and a contractual bundling denial cannot be transferred to the patient despite the remaining deductible. With no collectible payer or patient liability, the balance should be written off.","action":"write_off"}
